A118.rule: HISTORICAL-BOUNDARY:the former sovereign-sub-sovereign attachment is retired lineage under B162;a sovereign may address its registered managed modules directly without an intermediary,while every message still enters the canonical information-layer service and is carried only by the shared-layer typed transport implementation. ROUTE:sovereign identity -> information-layer authorization+contract+correlation -> shared-layer logical stream -> managed module identity,and the reverse path uses the same contract. BIDIRECTIONAL:request,response,event,acknowledgement,cancellation,health,dispatch-status and evidence may originate from either endpoint within its role. BOUNDARY:direct means logical endpoint selection only;it never means in-process bypass,direct filesystem/database access,private import,unaudited IPC or authority inheritance. VALIDATION:each stream proves current registration,active identity,role,scope,permission,generation,schema,deadline,sequence and correlation before delivery. AUTHORITY:the sovereign retains only its declared decision or privileged power;the managed module retains implementation duties and gains no decision authority. INFORMATION-OWNERSHIP:information-layer owns information service and routing truth;shared-layer implements channel and contract;automation-sovereign operates and maintains transport;permission-sovereign decides access. ISOLATION:one sovereign-module stream has its own queue,budget,backpressure,checkpoint and fault domain;failure cannot interrupt unrelated streams. TOPOLOGY:attachment is resolved dynamically from the registered module ownership and identity generation,never from hard-coded physical addresses.
A118.exception: A pure call wholly inside one process,module,owner,trust,principal,generation and state-owner remains an internal implementation call under the call-boundary rule;once sovereign or sub-sovereign identities differ,this direct-route article applies.
A118.prohibition: FORBID:direct-call bypass of information-layer+private cross-boundary method/import used as transport+permission inheritance from attachment+sub-sovereign revival+module self-authorization+unregistered attachment+hard-coded endpoint+cross-stream credential/evidence reuse+uncorrelated response+stale-generation delivery+failure propagation.
